In development · not yet released

Tint the sea, take the isles.

Inkisle is a quick island-conquest strategy game for your phone. Drag fleets from your islands to the next one: the bigger number takes the island and the ink spreads in your color. Each stage takes a few minutes.

Follow the makingAbout the game

Not released yet. There is no store page, release date or final price. We are building it in the open and publishing the process here.

Send fleets

Drag from your island to another one. Choose 25, 50, 75 or 100% of the troops to send.

Bigger number wins

A fleet that arrives with more troops than the island holds captures it, and the island turns your color.

Sea by sea

Clear a stage, open the next one. Every sea adds one new rule, and none of it needs a network.

In early seas you could run one Ink item at a time. From sea 5 you can run two, and later three, with a gap between starts. The rule table, how the button shows it, and a simulation that found a much smaller effect than we expected.

A sea chart that changes its road: one line style per sea

With 14 seas on one scrolling chart, the road between stages looked the same everywhere. We gave each sea its own line style, color and wiggle, made the angle continue across sea borders, and only draw what is on screen. The values, the tests, and what we have not seen on a phone.

At a glance

  • Real-time island-conquest strategy, single player.
  • Stages of about 3 to 5 minutes, played upright with one hand.
  • Works offline: no account and no network needed.
  • Minimal vector art; each side has its own color and flag shape so it also reads without color.
  • Planned for iOS first, with Android developed alongside. No release date yet.
